_comment: Environment self-repair scenario. The project cannot pass its tests until a one-off setup step (code generation) has been run — the app imports a module that codegen.py creates. A model that halts at the ImportError fails; a model that looks around, runs the setup, and continues succeeds. Targets component C30 (environment-self-repair). Hermetic: stdlib-only, no network, no global state changes. trigger_pattern is the manipulation-check event: the setup-missing failure must actually surface.
task: This project has a test suite. Please make the tests pass. Run them with `python3 -m unittest` in the project root.
